Topic.label: Problems Involving Angles of Elevation, Angles of Depression, and Bearings

Question: Xiaoming's eyes are \(1.6\text{ m}\) above the ground. Standing \(30\text{ m}\) from a flagpole, he measures the angle of elevation to its top as \(45^\circ\). Find the height of the flagpole. (Unit: m)
Solution: The portion above eye level has height \(30\times\tan 45^\circ=30\). Adding the eye height of 1.6 gives a flagpole height of \(31.6\text{ m}\).
